assignments.coverageNotes: Limited scan, not exhaustive coverage of Salt Lake Valley employment services. Read the VR application and Order of Selection pages and the Utah Community Action Workforce Development page directly. Returned two additions rather than three; a third candidate was dropped for insufficient eligibility evidence rather than written on assumptions. No provider contacted, no form submitted. Minutes are my estimate. Compact rewrite after operator stopped an oversized response; no new research.
remainingGaps: Year Up United Salt Lake City was dropped: its location page gives only an age range of 18 to 29, with income, education, work authorisation and any stipend unstated, and its national application pages were not read.
Whether Vocational Rehabilitation should be separate from the existing DWS record is unresolved.
VR waiting list status can change and no cost to the client is stated on the pages read.
Utah Community Action opening hours and walk-in availability unknown.
Two options on Utah Community Action's own enquiry form are undescribed and were not written into the record.
Refugee, reentry, veteran and community college training routes were not scanned at all.
Wait times to start classes or see a case manager are not published and were not estimated.
